combo_label: Birthdays × Butterflies & Moths × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Dying soul of a Newman poem, set to music for Birmingham in 1900
Gustav of the Planets who also gave In the Bleak Midwinter its tune
Festive song that began life as a circling mediaeval dance
Rundown handed to relatives so nobody buys the wrong jumper
Rubber sphere inflated and knotted, doomed to meet a pin
Hanging donkey of coloured paper, whacked till it rains goodies
Sealed, motionless stage in which a grub reorganises into an adult insect
Red insect that hauls a Large Blue grub into its nest, where the guest eats its young
Steady glow from a bulb or a paraffin wick, which moths circle after dark
Tiny overlapping tiles that colour a wing and dust your fingers if you touch
Lion of the zodiac, roaring through the height of summer
The first one, per the song, was to certain poor shepherds
